items.description: Renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia could spread beyond Tigray and destabilize the wider Horn of Africa, an International Crisis Group analyst warned

items.title: France welcomes Leo XIV at Orly Airport as bells sound nationwide
items.description: Pope Leo XIV begins historic four-day visit to France with focus on Europe’s future.

items.title: After several difficult years, economists now expect German economy to grow
items.description: Germany's economy is growing again, but recovery remains on shaky ground. High government spending is keeping the economy afloat, while energy prices, a shortage of skilled workers and debt continue to weigh on it.

items.title: TikTok reaches first state settlement over teen safety claims, agrees to user limits
items.description: The agreement, which came days before a scheduled trial, calls for TikTok to implement changes for teenagers in Alabama including a two-hour daily time limit, pauses after 15 minutes of use and stricter age checks.
